title: copy: add OmitManifestUpdateIfUnchanged option
body:
When copying multi-arch images with `OptimizeDestinationImageAlreadyExists: true`, child manifests are skipped but parent manifest list still unconditionally updated. registries that enforce tag immutability like Harbor or Artifactory writing the exact same parent manifest list fails the entire sync as tag already exist. Added a new `OmitManifestUpdateIfUnchanged` boolean to `copy.Options`. updated `copyManifest` (`single.go`) & `copyMultipleImages` (`multiple.go`) to fetch the existing manifest from the destination and skip the `PutManifest` call if the bytes are completely identical. Short-circuit check only triggers for top-level manifests where `instanceDigest == nil`. avoids introducing unnecessary HTTP overhead when pushing child images by digest.

- Fixes: #918

comments.body:
